items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Jay McShann had a band... Coleman was up there, Teddy was up there with his band, Jay McShann had a band

ctx.x: Yeah. This is the one that's the hard one to play! He was a good tenor player, too. You know, at one time it was, like, Coleman and Prince Robinson. That's when the big Cotton Pickers was goin', you know.

So we went out of there, made it to... After being on the air. And we came back to New York, we were off for a little while, and then we went to the Arcadia again. But we only stayed four months this time.
